title: Sources Sought – FY27 Temporary Backup Generator and Transformer Lease and Sustainment – Winn Army Community Hospital, Fort Stewart, Georgia
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > AMC > ACC > MISSION & INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND > 419TH CSB > W6QM MICC-FT STEWART
description:
The Department of the Army is conducting market research to identify capable commercial sources for a potential firm-fixed-price service requirement at Winn Army Community Hospital, Fort Stewart, Georgia. The anticipated requirement is for contractor-furnished temporary backup power generation equipment, including a generator and compatible transformer, to support the hospital chiller plant during planned or unplanned power outages. 

 The contractor would provide equipment lease/rental, transition or installation as required, testing and commissioning, 24/7 operational readiness, preventive and corrective maintenance, monitoring, emergency response, and removal/decommissioning at the end of performance. The Government seeks input regarding available commercial solutions, transition approach, equipment availability, schedule, pricing structure, and small-business capability. 

 This notice is for market-research purposes only and is not a solicitation or commitment to award. The Government has not determined whether existing temporary-power equipment will be available to a successor contractor. Respondents should address their ability to sustain an existing system, if lawfully made available, and to provide a replacement system if necessary. 

  

  Attachment:  A Draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) is attached for market-research reference. The draft PWS is preliminary, subject to revision, and provided solely to assist interested parties in assessing capability. It is not a solicitation, request for quotation, request for proposal, or commitment by the Government. Respondents are encouraged to identify any requirements that may unnecessarily restrict competition and recommend commercially reasonable alternatives.
